### Remember the Loaves
Author: Binu Samuel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-31-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 16:9
Points:
- Believers often slip into anxiety over fresh trials even after witnessing answered prayer.
- Jesus challenged His disciples for worrying about bread after He had already fed thousands.
- The disciples' confusion over Jesus' warning exposed their forgetfulness of His miraculous power.
- Recalling past moments of God's faithful provision brings peace and courage in current struggles.

### When the Prodigal Church Comes Home
Author: Jared Wilson
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-the-prodigal-church-comes-home
Passage: Mark 8:15
Points:
- The leaven of the Pharisees represents legalistic self-righteousness, while Herod's leaven represents worldly license.
- Just a small amount of either influence can subtly spread and corrupt the whole community.
- Churches often mistakenly try to cure worldliness with legalism, or legalism with worldly indulgence.
- Both legalism and licentiousness are flawed self-salvation projects rather than true remedies.
- Jesus warns against both forms of leaven so believers will look only to Him as their true bread.
